item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently makes the statutory determination required to extend waiver authority under the Trade Act; the legally consequential determination occurs in this segment itself.","evidence":"I hereby determine, pursuant to section 402(d)(5) of the Act"},{"segment_id":"2","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently makes the country-specific statutory determination supporting continuation of Romania's existing waiver, rather than directing an agency to reach that result later.","evidence":"continuation of the waiver applicable to the Socialist Republic of Romania will substantially promote the objectives of section 402"}]}
